videos.desc: In a bright science laboratory, a young woman with a red braid, safety glasses, a white lab coat and blue gloves sits at a bench and collects drops from a tall vertical glass tube clamped to a metal stand. The tube is filled with white powder showing a green band and a yellow band, and a tap at its bottom lets liquid drip into small test tubes in a metal rack, which she moves along. Behind her a young man in a lab coat writes notes at the next bench under a desk lamp.

The great hall of an old university, with tall Gothic windows, stone walls and a dark wooden roof. A young woman in a black academic gown with red trim and a gold chain of office stands barefoot on a wooden desk, shouting with one arm raised while papers fly through the air and fall to the floor. She then shades her eyes and points across the hall. Behind her a row of staff in black gowns hold cardboard boxes, two people stand on ladders at a window and a dog stands among the fallen papers.

A building site at golden hour. A young woman in a khaki work shirt and trousers kneels at the bottom of a freshly dug trench, brushing earth away with a paintbrush to uncover a colourful ancient mosaic of a face made of small stones. She raises her other hand to her mouth in surprise and stares at it. Above her, construction workers in hard hats and yellow safety vests lean over the edge and stare down, one putting his hands on his head, while a small digger and a cement mixer stand behind them.

In a bright restoration studio full of white plaster busts on shelves, a young woman in a white lab coat and gloves rubs a long cotton swab on the cheek of a bust of a man that looks like old brown marble. Where she cleans, the brown colour comes off and plain white plaster shows underneath. She leans in, frowns with doubt and touches the white patch with her finger. A tray of used cotton swabs, white powder and a jar of liquid lie around it, and two colleagues work behind her.

On a wet city rooftop under dark clouds at sunset, a young woman in a yellow rain jacket lifts a large metal rectangle out of a long trough of soapy water. A thin, shiny soap film stretches across it, shimmering with rainbow colours and billowing in the wind as she raises it higher. A young man crouches behind it and reaches up to touch the soap film with his fingers, while another person holds up a small wind meter. Skyscrapers and a water tower rise in the background.

On a wet country road under a dark green storm sky, a huge tornado touches down over flat fields as lightning flashes. A young red-haired woman in a yellow raincoat and cap holds a camera whose flip-out screen shows the tornado she has just recorded. She shouts at first, then grins in excitement as two young men crowd in to stare at the screen, one clutching his head, and another young man with a large camera joins them. A muddy pickup truck and broken boards are behind them.

At a sunny outdoor science show, a heavy iron wrecking ball hanging from a yellow crane smashes into a tall pyramid of stacked watermelons, and pink juice and pieces burst into the air. The pyramid collapses and watermelons roll across the ground as the ball swings back. In front, a young man with curly hair, safety glasses and a juice-spattered white lab coat holds a red lever and cheers with one arm up. A young woman in a lab coat records it on a tablet, and a crowd behind a barrier watches.

On moving-in day in a sunny student dormitory, a young woman in a grey hoodie and white trainers walks in from a busy corridor carrying a cardboard box full of bedding, a desk lamp and a small cactus, with a paper campus map held in her teeth. She hurries into the room, grinning. A bare metal bed with a blue mattress, an empty wooden desk and a cork board wait in the room. In the corridor behind her, other students carry boxes and a woman wheels in a small fridge.

A young man in a black gown with a gold stole lands from a jump in a crouch on the lawn in front of an old stone university building, then springs up and stands with both arms raised high, holding a rolled diploma with a red ribbon and shouting with joy. His black square cap lies on the grass in front of him. Behind him a big crowd of graduates in gowns and families holding flowers and balloons cheer beside a wooden podium.

A young woman with her hair in a bun, a grey shirt and a black top holds up a printed page showing a blue moth and pins it onto a wall covered in neatly pinned book pages, where pictures of flowers, fruit and insects sit between columns of text. She smooths the page flat with her hand and looks at it with a smile. On the table in front lie stacks of prints, brushes in jars and a tin of pins, while another woman works on a ladder and a third sits at a desk behind, in a bright studio with tall windows.

In a ruined stone castle, a bearded man with round glasses, in a tweed jacket and white cotton gloves, holds an old yellowed plan of the building up against the wall beside a brick archway and compares it with the stones. He turns his head from the plan to the wall and breaks into a happy smile. In front of him a folding table holds a laptop, old leather books, a magnifying glass and an open sketchbook with floor plans. Ivy grows over the walls, a crow flies off the top and visitors walk along the path behind.

In a laboratory, a young woman scientist with long braids, safety glasses pushed up on her head, a white lab coat and purple gloves drops liquid from a pipette into a small glass of yellow fluid. She then puts the pipette aside, looks down at a printed graph with one sharp peak and smiles. On the steel bench are a rack of blood sample tubes with coloured caps, a sample tray and a model of the thyroid gland. An open centrifuge stands behind her, and a young man at the back holds up a tube.

In an empty lecture hall, a balloon tied to a metal stand on a long wooden bench bursts into a huge rolling ball of orange flame, next to a long metal rod with a small flame at its tip. The fireball rises, darkens and turns into thick grey smoke that drifts up to the ceiling, leaving only the small flame burning. A small gas cylinder, safety goggles, a glass beaker and a red fire blanket lie on the bench. A blackboard with formulas, a fire extinguisher, rows of empty seats and another balloon are behind.

An old library with tall dark wooden bookshelves. A young woman with long red-brown hair, in a cream cable-knit cardigan and a black skirt, stands on a wooden ladder and pushes a thick brown book into a gap on a high shelf until it slides in. She then steps down a rung, smiles and looks up at the shelf. A grey cat sits on the shelf above beside a pile of books and watches her. Behind her a couple covers their mouths nervously and then claps, and soft light falls into the room.

A research camp on a sunny snowfield. A young woman scientist in a red down jacket and gloves holds up a long clear cylinder of ice from a drill and studies it, her breath steaming. A bearded man in a red jacket and dark hat steps in beside her and points at the ice, and she smiles. Beside them stands a metal drill rig, and other men in red jackets and orange snow trousers look on. Boxes of ice samples sit on a wooden sledge with coiled rope, and red tents, flags and jagged mountains are behind them.

An old university lecture hall seen from the back rows, lit by a tall window. A young woman lecturer with her hair in a bun, in a green dress and dark cardigan, stands at a long wooden demonstration bench with a sink and a wooden pointer and looks at a student who raises her hand. She then walks to the tall sliding blackboards covered in chalk and points at them. Rows of students with long hair sit at curved wooden desks taking notes in open notebooks, and a clock hangs above the door.

A huge old library at night during a thunderstorm. Tall dark wooden bookshelves full of books rise up both walls to galleries with iron railings, and a rolling brass ladder stands by the shelves. A long reading table with green desk lamps runs down the left side. Through a tall Gothic window with a round rose window, bright lightning flashes outside. A white barn owl flies towards the viewer with spread wings as loose sheets of paper flutter down, and lands on top of the ladder, where it folds its wings and sits.

A snowy mountain summit ridge at sunrise, high above a sea of clouds. A male climber in a red and black down suit, his beard covered in frost, kneels in the snow and breathes through a mask that a young woman in a yellow hooded down suit holds to his face, connected to an orange gas cylinder. Steam comes from the mask, then he stands up with the cylinder while she stays kneeling. A second orange cylinder lies in the snow, and other climbers walk up the slope below.

In a flooded museum hall with a leaking glass roof, where rain pours down in a stream, two monkeys in small aprons and white gloves stand on a stone pedestal and guide an ancient clay jar, hanging in a rope sling from a beam, back down onto its place until it stands on the pedestal. Another monkey climbs the rope above, one on a wooden crate holds a board and a lit torch, and one sits in the water on the marble floor. Glass cases, a stepladder, a fallen bust and coils of rope fill the hall.

A science lab with long white benches. In front, a live orange-brown octopus sits on a glass jar of water, pulls off its metal lid with its arms, slides into the jar and lifts the lid up above it. Behind it stand two silver humanoid robots with open wiring, not moving. At the back a young woman scientist in a white coat clutches her head and laughs, and a man in a lab coat holding a clipboard stares. An open fish tank, screws, notes and a coffee cup lie on the bench.

A biology lab with pale green tiles and many plants by the windows. Young students in white lab coats work at black benches with a microscope, petri dishes of moss, a tray of flowers, a pile of seed pods and small glass tanks with plants. In the middle a young woman in white gloves holds a green frog in her cupped hands, holds it out towards the viewer and smiles widely. Other students hold plant pots, and a teacher in a lab coat stands in the doorway with a tray of seedlings.

A modern city square on a sunny day, with glass office towers and a tram behind. In the middle stands a tall, cracked ancient marble column with a pigeon on top. Around its base the pavement is a glass floor, and under the glass lie old stone paving and a patterned mosaic. A young woman in a dark red outfit kneels and looks down through the glass, and a man stands with a hand on the column. A young man in a blue shirt jumps a skateboard onto the glass and rolls past her as the pigeon flies away.

An old lecture hall with wooden benches, round hanging lamps and a tall arched window with autumn leaves outside. A young man in a green jumper sits with his chin in his hand and a faint smile, staring off into space with a pencil loose in his fingers, and knocks over his paper coffee cup so coffee runs down the desk. The young woman next to him reaches over in alarm, picks up the cup and holds it out to him, while he keeps dreaming. Other students read and take notes behind.

Three young people doing fieldwork in a wide glacial river valley under a stormy grey sky. A young woman in a blue jacket and waders stands in the pale blue water holding a tall striped measuring pole. A young man in a mustard fleece throws an orange float into the current, loses his balance and falls into the river, ending up sitting in the water, while a young woman in a maroon jacket and beige hat holds a measuring tape stretched across the river. A clipboard and backpacks lie on the stones, and snowy mountains and a glacier rise behind.

A rocky beach below a tall cliff of striped red, cream and brown rock layers. A young man in a navy jacket and orange T-shirt kneels on a flat rock and splits a stone open with a hammer, chips of rock flying, then lifts one half and reveals a spiral fossil shell inside. A young woman in a yellow jacket leans in with a small hand lens and stares at it with her mouth open. Two more students measure the cliff layers with a tall pole, and a notebook and backpacks lie nearby, with the sea and a blue sky behind.

The doorway of an old university lecture hall, seen from the viewer's place. The viewer, in a rust-coloured sweater, pushes open a heavy wooden door with one hand and holds a paper coffee cup in the other. Inside, rows of wooden benches rise in tiers, filled with young students waiting for the lecture, and a young man walks down the steps to his seat. A young woman in a green sweater turns around, looks at the latecomer and smiles. Tall arched windows and hanging lamps light the wood-panelled room.

A science laboratory with white brick walls, steel beams, hanging bulbs and glass cabinets. A young woman in a mustard jumper and black shorts stands on a mat on a lab bench with her hands on the large silver metal dome of a static electricity generator. Her long dark hair stands straight out from her head in every direction; she laughs, touches her hair in surprise, and then it falls back down. A young man in a light blue shirt beside the bench turns the generator's handle and looks up at her, smiling.

An exam in a large hall with tall windows and a big clock on the wall. A tall young man in a navy jumper, the supervisor, stands at a desk and pulls away an exam paper while looking up at the ceiling. The young woman in a green cardigan sitting there holds on to the paper and keeps writing on it, desperate to finish, until he takes it from her. He stands holding the paper with his eyes closed, and she sits back with her pen in her hand. Rows of students sit at small desks behind them.

An old stone university building on a bright autumn morning. A man in a navy suit pulls open the big wooden doors at the top of the steps. A smiling young woman in a mustard cardigan and jeans, with a green backpack and books in her arms, runs up the stone steps, followed by a young man in a blue jumper with a backpack. At the top all three stand by the open doors, smiling and laughing. Orange and red leaves lie on the steps, and bicycles stand by the wall.

A university library late at night, with snowy rooftops and a dark blue sky outside the tall windows. At a long wooden table under green reading lamps, several students sleep with their heads on open books and paper coffee cups. Behind them a young woman with long braids in a lilac top and black trousers jumps high into the air with her arms and legs spread wide, lands and bounces again, full of energy. A cleaner with a mop stands at the far end of the room.

A young woman in a blue top and blue trousers stands on a stepladder in a bright server room, colourful cables hanging around her neck. She plugs a yellow cable into a tall black server rack and smiles. Below her, a young man in a grey beanie holds a big bundle of cables and looks up at her, laughing. More cables run along the ceiling and lie under an open floor panel. The two look like students of computer science who are learning how computers and networks really work.
